newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian dlr dives 1/2 cent after RBA cuts rates.
newsitem.headline: Australian dlr dives 1/2 cent after RBA cuts rates.

text.p: The Australian dollar dived 1/2 cent Friday after the Reserve Bank cut its official cash rate by 0.5 point to 5.5 percent.

There had been considerable speculation this morning the bank would move after press reports claimed wages data released Thursday had eased the bank's concerns on inflation. However, the broader market had thought policy would stay steady for the remainder of the year and expected offshore investors to react negatively to the dollar's narrowing interest differential.
By 9.33 am (2233 GMT) the dollar had slid to US$0.7700/10 from an early US$0.7763/68 and US$0.7830/35 late here Thursday.
